brief: Early-1990s discount superstore on the edge of town: one huge single-storey box of painted concrete block and ribbed metal panels with a flat roof, a raised entrance vestibule with a red-and-white banded fascia and big letters, cart corrals, and a sea of parking with tall light poles. Garden centre fenced off at one end, loading docks behind.

facade.notes: the former Super Kmart (Medina OH, 1991): a vast low beige box with two pyramidal glass-roofed entrance vestibules with red bases, an empty cracked parking lot with light poles and landscape islands -- a dead big box

why.note: the discount store: one huge single-storey box at the edge of town, a sea of parking in front sized for the year's busiest day
the 2000s-10s discount-chain collapses left empty boxes on every arterial
